description: This Dart file defines the AppDatabase class, a singleton wrapper around the sqflite plugin for local SQLite database management. It handles database initialization, schema migrations, and provides methods for executing queries, inserts, updates, transactions, and closing the database. The database manages folders and documents, with schema definitions and indices, supporting a secure document wallet application.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: A singleton class managing the local SQLite database for a secure document wallet, including schema creation, migrations, and query helpers.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of AppDatabase.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the database, creating schema if necessary, using versioning and migration.

methods.name: _migrateToV1
methods.description: Creates the initial database schema for version 1, including 'folders' and 'documents' tables and indices.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a parameterized SQL update (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE).

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Executes a parameterized SQL insert and returns the inserted row ID.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Performs a parameterized SQL query and returns a list of result maps.

methods.name: transaction
methods.description: Runs a set of database operations atomically within a transaction.
